_comment: Real MCP server wiring. Copy to servers.json and edit paths.
Both Unity and Unreal MCP servers are stdio processes, same as the fake one,
so mcpbridge/client.py drives them without changes.
Unity: MCP for Unity (CoplayDev) exposes ~10 umbrella tools; the Unity Editor
must be running with the MCP for Unity package installed and the bridge connected.
Unreal: most community servers need the Python plugin enabled in the project
(Edit > Plugins > Python Editor Script Plugin) and remote execution turned on.

unity.notes: Path is what the MCP for Unity window prints under 'Manual Configuration'.

unreal.notes: Start the Unreal Editor first; the server connects to the editor bridge.
